svg.title: A — Failover: missing push ACK, SMS, late ACK race

g.text: A — Failover: missing push ACK, SMS, late ACK race
Notification already accepted; push attempted; no app ACK.
absolute push deadline at accepted_at + 2 s
Both channels may already have reached the user.
No new sends; an in-flight external request cannot be reliably recalled.
Generic 5xx or lost response = UNKNOWN, not proven rejection.
Reconcile using the original key; choose next channel under deadline.
